description: Base de datos de los Trabajos de investigación geotécnica relacionados con los proyectos y obras de ferroviarias del País Vasco is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.euskadi.eus. Data set, historical and future, formed by the collection of surveys, calicates and DPSH carried out for different projects and works related to the different railway platforms of the Basque Country or other projects linked to Euskal Trenbide Sarea, Eustrotren and Imebisa. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Database of geotechnical research work related to railway projects and works in the Basque Country" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
